caption: The drawing depicts a pair of metal nutcrackers positioned upright and joined at the center, with the handles splayed outward in a symmetrical "V" shape. The handles display a crisscross pattern for grip, and each side is adorned with ornate, swirling designs around the central section. The main body of the nutcrackers is inscribed with the word "DOG" and includes additional decorative elements. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background, and there are two small punched holes near the upper corners of the paper. At the lower right of the image, the artist’s name, "Claude H. Marshall," is written in small brown text.
title: Bootjack
